title: Eating Raoul
description: The absurd Blandslure swingers home to be conked by a skillet, robbed and removed by Raoul.

title: The Host
description: When an unseen enemy threatens mankind by taking over humans' bodies and erasing their minds, Melanie Stryder risks everything to protect the people she cares about most, proving that love can conquer all in a dangerous new world.

title: Sleepaway Camp
description: Bunks and the showers are a mad stabber's beat at a summer camp strictly for teens.

title: Tragedy Girls
description: Teenage crime reporters Sadie and McKayla are hot on the trail of a crazed serial killer. After capturing the maniac and holding him hostage, they soon realize that the best way to boost their social media stardom is to commit the murders themselves.

title: Take Me Home Tonight
description: A directionless college grad (Topher Grace) sees a chance to win the girl of his dreams when she invites him to a huge end-of-summer party.

title: Marlowe
description: Detective Philip Marlowe becomes embroiled in an investigation with a wealthy family in Bay City, Calif., after a beautiful blonde hires him to find her former lover.

title: Among Wolves
description: Two missionaries witness a murder by hired guns and go on the run. They stumble onto the cabin of two retired contract killers who agree to help the women find safety, but only their guns can secure that promise.

title: Alligator
description: A herpetologist helps a detective track her flushed-away pet, now a king-size mutant called Ramone.

title: The Pledge
description: A detective about to retire promises a woman to catch her daughter's murderer.

title: The Battle of Algiers
description: Between 1954 and '62, Algeria fights for independence from the French.

title: The Company
description: A young woman (Neve Campbell) works as a nightclub waitress while becoming a rising ballerina in Chicago.

title: Communion
description: A novelist's (Christopher Walken) wife (Lindsay Crouse) and son (Joel Carlson) see him changed by an apparent encounter with aliens in the mountains.

title: Boyka: Undisputed 4
description: Boyka accidentally kills an opponent in the ring, forcing him to question everything he's worked for. When he finds out his opponent's widow is in trouble, he becomes her champion in a series of seemingly impossible fights.

title: Inland Empire
description: Two actors (Laura Dern, Justin Theroux) star in a remake of a film which was originally unfinished because its leads were murdered.

title: Day of the Dead
description: The living dead regroup above while humans (Lori Cardille, Terry Alexander, Joseph Pilato) sweat it out below in a Florida missile silo.

title: Red Riding: 1974
description: A rookie crime reporter (Andrew Garfield) becomes intrigued by a missing-child case that mirrors that of a series of child abductions and murders that took place in previous years.

title: Itsy Bitsy
description: An ancient mysterious relic unleashes a giant prehistoric spider that terrorizes a single mother and her two children in their new house.

title: Fast Vengeance
description: Determined to find those responsible for his brother's death, a man infiltrates the dangerous and high-stakes world of underground motorcycle racing.

title: Midnight Sun
description: A teen who lives with a life-threatening sensitivity to sunlight finds romance with a young man she's admired for years. As their relationship starts to blossom, she desperately tries to hide her condition from her unsuspecting new beau.

title: Dreamscape
description: Two scientists (Kate Capshaw, Max von Sydow) have a psychic (Dennis Quaid) enter other's dreams to help them overcome their nightmares.

title: Freejack
description: Bounty hunters from the future transport a doomed race car driver to New York City in 2009, where his mind will be replaced with that of a dead billionaire.

title: Guns of Redemption
description: Searching for redemption, a mysterious gunslinger with a violent past tries to save a young woman from vicious men who run a traveling brothel.

title: The Decline of Western Civilization Part III
description: Filmmaker Penelope Spheeris examines the lives of young punk fans who live homeless on the streets of Los Angeles.

title: Just Getting Started
description: It's Christmas in the Dessert and an ex-F.B.I. Agent and an ex-mob lawyer in the Witness Protection Program must work together.

title: The Lady Vanishes
description: An heiress (Cybill Shepherd) and a photographer (Elliott Gould) are sure an English nanny (Angela Lansbury) was on their train in the Alps.

title: Shade
description: Two grifters join forces with two card players to swindle a legendary gambler in a high-stakes poker game.

title: Class of 1984
description: A high-school music teacher (Perry King) hunts a hoodlum student (Timothy Van Patten) for attacking his wife (Merrie Lynn Ross).

title: Drugstore June
description: June is a wannabe influencer who's juggling multiple problems: her parents want her to move out, her ex-boyfriend accuses her of stalking him, and two detectives think she may be involved in the robbery of a local pharmacy.

title: Villains
description: Amateur criminals stumble upon a dark secret in a sadistic couple's home.

title: C.H.U.D.
description: Lovers (John Heard, Kim Greist) and other New Yorkers face cannibalistic humanoid underground dwellers, spawned by toxic waste.

title: All I See Is You
description: In Bangkok, a young blind woman undergoes a cutting-edge operation that restores sight to her right eye. Able to see again, she slowly starts to realize that her newfound independence makes her husband feel jealous, threatened and insecure.

title: The Man Who Knew Too Much
description: Anarchists kidnap a couple's (Leslie Banks, Edna Best) daughter to hide a plot to kill a diplomat in London.

title: Coffee and Cigarettes
description: Vignettes revolve around a dentist appointment, a talkative waiter, musicians and celebrities.

title: Red Riding: 1980
description: Detective Peter Hunter returns to Yorkshire to investigate the town's high murder rate. The local police have done little to find the killer, and he soon realizes corrupt police officers are doing everything they can to stop his progress.

title: A Walk in the Woods
description: Travel writer Bill Bryson (Robert Redford) takes a long-lost old friend (Nick Nolte) for a hike along the Appalachian Trail, which stretches more than 2,000 miles from Georgia to Maine.

title: Crime Story
description: A Hong Kong detective (Jackie Chan) teams with a police veteran (Kent Cheng) to rescue a wealthy businessman from kidnappers.

title: Brain on Fire
description: Susannah Cahalan, an up-and-coming journalist at the New York Post, became plagued by voices in her head and seizures. As weeks progress and Susannah quickly moves deeper into insanity, her behaviors shift from violence to catatonia.

title: City Hunter
description: U.S. criminals hijack a cruise ship with a gluttonous private eye (Jackie Chan) aboard who is seeking a magnate's missing daughter.

title: Buena Vista Social Club
description: Filmmaker Wim Wenders shows a number of renowned Cuban musicians of all ages who gathered to create a Grammy-winning album.

title: The Little Hours
description: A young servant fleeing from his master takes refuge at a dysfunctional convent in medieval Tuscany, disguising himself as a deaf-mute.

title: Heathers
description: Cool Veronica (Winona Ryder) and her quirky new boyfriend (Christian Slater) topple a high-school trio of too-cool Heathers.

title: Emmet Otter's Jug-Band Christmas
description: Emmet Otter and his mother, Ma Otter, are dirt-poor, and they want to get a special present for each other by winning the talent show against the Riverbottom Gang, a group of rich kids with electric instruments.
